check_dataset: check a binary dataset for EOS token correctness and file size consistency
run_check_dataset_cli: run the check_dataset CLI tool on a dataset folder with a specified tokenizer
load_doc_ends: load document end positions from a binary .ds.index file as a list of uint64 values
load_dataset_bytes: read tokens from a binary .ds file in chunks defined by document end positions
test_check_dataset: test the check_dataset function to verify EOS tokens at the end of each document
